answer: Dust hangs in the empty room, and the plaster buckets stand by the door. Proof of plasterer via trowel coat tally — a coat the plasterer lays only after 30 coats dry smooth on the wall, each coat laid by the plasterer himself. canyon mixes the plaster thick and works it smooth on the hawk. summit lays the first coat and rules it flat with the straight edge. spiral floats the finish till the wall shines like a mirror. Copying this tally takes 30 coats dried without a hairline crack, and the thirty-first still crazes where the mix ran thin.
